name: SDTMIG v3.4
label: Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide: Human Clinical Trials Version 3.4 (Final)
description: Subset of SDTMIG v3.4 (DM, AE, VS, LB) for the Cadence Standards Registry seed.
source: Prepared by the CDISC Submission Data Standards Team

self.title: Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide: Human Clinical Trials Version 3.4 (Final)

datasetVariables.name: STUDYID
datasetVariables.label: Study Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

datasetVariables.name: DOMAIN
datasetVariables.label: Domain Abbreviation
datasetVariables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

datasetVariables.name: USUBJID
datasetVariables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product. This must be a unique value, and could be a compound identifier formed by concatenating STUDYID-SITEID-SUBJID.

datasetVariables.name: SUBJID
datasetVariables.label: Subject Identifier for the Study
datasetVariables.description: Subject identifier, which must be unique within the study. Often the ID of the subject as recorded on a CRF.

datasetVariables.name: RFSTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Subject Reference Start Date/Time
datasetVariables.description: Reference start date/time for the subject in ISO 8601 character format. Usually equivalent to date/time when subject was first exposed to study treatment. See assumption 9 for additional detail on when RFSTDTC may be null.

datasetVariables.name: RFENDTC
datasetVariables.label: Subject Reference End Date/Time
datasetVariables.description: Reference end date/time for the subject in ISO 8601 character format. Usually equivalent to the date/time when subject was determined to have ended the trial, and often equivalent to date/time of last exposure to study treatment. Required for all randomized subjects; null for screen failures or unassigned subjects.

datasetVariables.name: RFXSTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of First Study Treatment
datasetVariables.description: First date/time of exposure to any protocol-specified treatment or therapy, equal to the earliest value of EXSTDTC.

datasetVariables.name: RFXENDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Last Study Treatment
datasetVariables.description: Last date/time of exposure to any protocol-specified treatment or therapy, equal to the latest value of EXENDTC (or the latest value of EXSTDTC if EXENDTC was not collected or is missing).

datasetVariables.name: RFCSTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of First Challenge Agent Admin
datasetVariables.description: Used only when protocol specifies a challenge agent to induce a condition that the investigational treatment is intended to cure, mitigate, treat, or prevent. Equal to the earliest value of AGSTDTC for the challenge agent.

self.title: Date/Time of First Challenge Agent Admin

datasetVariables.name: RFCENDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Last Challenge Agent Admin
datasetVariables.description: Used only when protocol specifies a challenge agent to induce a condition that the investigational treatment is intended to cure, mitigate, treat, or prevent. Equal to the latest value of AGENDTC for the challenge agent (or the latest value of AGSTDTC if AGENDTC was not collected or is missing).

self.title: Date/Time of Last Challenge Agent Admin

datasetVariables.name: RFICDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Informed Consent
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of informed consent in ISO 8601 character format. This will be the same as the date of informed consent in the Disposition domain, if that protocol milestone is documented. Would be null only in studies not collecting the date of informed consent.

datasetVariables.name: RFPENDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of End of Participation
datasetVariables.description: Date/time when subject ended participation or follow-up in a trial, as defined in the protocol, in ISO 8601 character format. Should correspond to the last known date of contact. Examples include completion date, withdrawal date, last follow-up, date recorded for lost to follow up, and death date.

datasetVariables.name: DTHDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Death
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of death for any subject who died, in ISO 8601 format. Should represent the date/time that is captured in the clinical-trial database.

datasetVariables.name: DTHFL
datasetVariables.label: Subject Death Flag
datasetVariables.description: Indicates the subject died. Should be "Y" or null. Should be populated even when the death date is unknown.

datasetVariables.name: SITEID
datasetVariables.label: Study Site Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Unique identifier for a site within a study.

datasetVariables.name: INVID
datasetVariables.label: Investigator Identifier
datasetVariables.description: An identifier to describe the Investigator for the study. May be used in addition to SITEID. Not needed if SITEID is equivalent to INVID.

datasetVariables.name: INVNAM
datasetVariables.label: Investigator Name
datasetVariables.description: Name of the investigator for a site.

datasetVariables.name: BRTHDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Birth
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of birth of the subject.

datasetVariables.name: AGE
datasetVariables.label: Age
datasetVariables.description: Age expressed in AGEU. May be derived from RFSTDTC and BRTHDTC, but BRTHDTC may not be available in all cases (due to subject privacy concerns).

datasetVariables.name: AGEU
datasetVariables.label: Age Units
datasetVariables.description: Units associated with AGE.

datasetVariables.name: SEX
datasetVariables.label: Sex
datasetVariables.description: Sex of the subject.

datasetVariables.name: RACE
datasetVariables.label: Race
datasetVariables.description: Race of the subject. Sponsors should refer to the FDA guidance2 regarding the collection of race. See assumption below regarding RACE.

datasetVariables.name: ETHNIC
datasetVariables.label: Ethnicity
datasetVariables.description: The ethnicity of the subject. Sponsors should refer to the FDA guidance1 regarding the collection of ethnicity.

datasetVariables.name: ARMCD
datasetVariables.label: Planned Arm Code
datasetVariables.description: ARMCD is limited to 20 characters. It is not subject to the character restrictions that apply to TESTCD. The maximum length of ARMCD is longer than for other "short" variables to accommodate the kind of values that are likely to be needed for crossover trials. For example, if ARMCD values for a 7-period crossover were constructed using 2-character abbreviations for each treatment and separating hyphens, the length of ARMCD values would be 20. If the subject was not assigned to a trial arm, ARMCD is null and ARMNRS is populated. \n With the exception of studies which use multistage arm assignments, must be a value of ARMCD in the Trial Arms dataset.

datasetVariables.name: ARM
datasetVariables.label: Description of Planned Arm
datasetVariables.description: Name of the arm to which the subject was assigned. If the subject was not assigned to an arm, ARM is null and ARMNRS is populated. \n With the exception of studies which use multistage arm assignments, must be a value of ARM in the Trial Arms dataset.

datasetVariables.name: ACTARMCD
datasetVariables.label: Actual Arm Code
datasetVariables.description: Code of actual arm. ACTARMCD is limited to 20 characters. It is not subject to the character restrictions that apply to TESTCD. The maximum length of ACTARMCD is longer than for other short variables to accommodate the kind of values that are likely to be needed for crossover trials. \n With the exception of studies which use multistage arm assignments, must be a value of ARMCD in the Trial Arms dataset. \n If the subject was not assigned to an arm or followed a course not described by any planned arm, ACTARMCD is null and ARMNRS is populated.

datasetVariables.name: ACTARM
datasetVariables.label: Description of Actual Arm
datasetVariables.description: Description of actual arm. \n With the exception of studies which use multistage arm assignments, must be a value of ARM in the Trial Arms dataset. \n If the subject was not assigned to an arm or followed a course not described by any planned arm, ACTARM is null and ARMNRS is populated.

datasetVariables.name: ARMNRS
datasetVariables.label: Reason Arm and/or Actual Arm is Null
datasetVariables.description: A coded reason that arm variables (ARM and ARMCD) and/or actual arm variables (ACTARM and ACTARMCD) are null. Examples: "SCREEN FAILURE", "NOT ASSIGNED", "ASSIGNED, NOT TREATED", "UNPLANNED TREATMENT". It is assumed that if the arm and actual arm variables are null, the same reason applies to both arm and actual arm.

self.title: Reason Arm and/or Actual Arm is Null

datasetVariables.name: ACTARMUD
datasetVariables.label: Description of Unplanned Actual Arm
datasetVariables.description: A description of actual treatment for a subject who did not receive treatment described in a planned trial arm.

datasetVariables.name: COUNTRY
datasetVariables.label: Country
datasetVariables.description: Country of the investigational site in which the subject participated in the trial. \n \n Generally represented using ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3. Note that regulatory agency specific requirements (e.g., US FDA) may require other terminologies; in such cases, follow regulatory requirements.

datasetVariables.name: DMDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Collection
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of demographic data collection.

datasetVariables.name: DMDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of Collection
datasetVariables.description: Study day of collection measured as integer days.

datasets.name: AE
datasets.label: Adverse Events
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per adverse event per subject

datasetVariables.name: STUDYID
datasetVariables.label: Study Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

datasetVariables.name: DOMAIN
datasetVariables.label: Domain Abbreviation
datasetVariables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

datasetVariables.name: USUBJID
datasetVariables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

datasetVariables.name: SPDEVID
datasetVariables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
datasetVariables.description: A sequence of characters used by the sponsor to uniquely identify a specific device. Used to represent a device associated in some way with the adverse event. SPDEVID values are defined in the Device Identifiers (DI) domain.

datasetVariables.name: AESEQ
datasetVariables.label: Sequence Number
datasetVariables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. May be any valid number.

datasetVariables.name: AEGRPID
datasetVariables.label: Group ID
datasetVariables.description: Used to tie together a block of related records in a single domain for a subject.

datasetVariables.name: AEREFID
datasetVariables.label: Reference ID
datasetVariables.description: Internal or external identifier such as a serial number on an SAE reporting form.

datasetVariables.name: AESPID
datasetVariables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Sponsor-defined identifier. It may be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database. Example: Line number on an Adverse Events CRF page.

datasetVariables.name: AETERM
datasetVariables.label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Verbatim name of the event.

self.title: Reported Term for the Adverse Event

datasetVariables.name: AEMODIFY
datasetVariables.label: Modified Reported Term
datasetVariables.description: If AETERM is modified to facilitate coding, then AEMODIFY will contain the modified text.

datasetVariables.name: AELLT
datasetVariables.label: Lowest Level Term
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of the lowest level term.

datasetVariables.name: AELLTCD
datasetVariables.label: Lowest Level Term Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived code for the lowest level term.

datasetVariables.name: AEDECOD
datasetVariables.label: Dictionary-Derived Term
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of AETERM or AEMODIFY. Equivalent to the Preferred Term (PT in MedDRA). The sponsor is expected to provide the dictionary name and version used to map the terms utilizing the external codelist element in the Define-XML document.

datasetVariables.name: AEPTCD
datasetVariables.label: Preferred Term Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived code for the preferred term.

datasetVariables.name: AEHLT
datasetVariables.label: High Level Term
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of the high level term for the primary system organ class (SOC).

datasetVariables.name: AEHLTCD
datasetVariables.label: High Level Term Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived code for the high level term for the primary SOC.

datasetVariables.name: AEHLGT
datasetVariables.label: High Level Group Term
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of the high level group term for the primary SOC.

datasetVariables.name: AEHLGTCD
datasetVariables.label: High Level Group Term Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived code for the high level group term for the primary SOC.

datasetVariables.name: AECAT
datasetVariables.label: Category for Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Used to define a category of related records. Examples: "BLEEDING", "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC".

datasetVariables.name: AESCAT
datasetVariables.label: Subcategory for Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: A further categorization of adverse event. Example: "NEUROLOGIC".

datasetVariables.name: AEPRESP
datasetVariables.label: Pre-Specified Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: A value of "Y" indicates that this adverse event was prespecified on the CRF. Values are null for spontaneously reported events (i.e., those collected as free-text verbatim terms).

datasetVariables.name: AEBODSYS
datasetVariables.label: Body System or Organ Class
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary derived. Body system or organ class used by the sponsor from the coding dictionary (e.g., MedDRA). When using a multi-axial dictionary such as MedDRA, this should contain the SOC used for the sponsor's analyses and summary tables, which may not necessarily be the primary SOC.

datasetVariables.name: AEBDSYCD
datasetVariables.label: Body System or Organ Class Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary derived. Code for the body system or organ class used by the sponsor. When using a multi-axial dictionary such as MedDRA, this should contain the SOC used for the sponsor's analyses and summary tables, which may not necessarily be the primary SOC.

self.title: Body System or Organ Class Code

datasetVariables.name: AESOC
datasetVariables.label: Primary System Organ Class
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of the primary SOC. Will be the same as AEBODSYS if the primary SOC was used for analysis.

datasetVariables.name: AESOCCD
datasetVariables.label: Primary System Organ Class Code
datasetVariables.description: Dictionary-derived code for the primary SOC. Will be the same as AEBDSYCD if the primary SOC was used for analysis.

datasetVariables.name: AELOC
datasetVariables.label: Location of Event
datasetVariables.description: Describes anatomical location relevant for the event (e.g., "ARM" for skin rash).

datasetVariables.name: AESEV
datasetVariables.label: Severity/Intensity
datasetVariables.description: The severity or intensity of the event. Examples: "MILD", "MODERATE", "SEVERE".

datasetVariables.name: AESER
datasetVariables.label: Serious Event
datasetVariables.description: Is this a serious event? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AEACN
datasetVariables.label: Action Taken with Study Treatment
datasetVariables.description: Describes changes to the study treatment as a result of the event. AEACN is specifically for the relationship to study treatment. AEACNOTH is for actions unrelated to dose adjustments of study treatment. Examples of AEACN values include ICH E2B values: "DRUG WITHDRAWN", "DOSE REDUCED", "DOSE INCREASED", "DOSE NOT CHANGED", "UNKNOWN" and "NOT APPLICABLE".

datasetVariables.name: AEACNOTH
datasetVariables.label: Other Action Taken
datasetVariables.description: Describes other actions taken as a result of the event that are unrelated to dose adjustments of study treatment. Usually reported as free text. Example: "TREATMENT UNBLINDED. PRIMARY CARE PHYSICIAN NOTIFIED".

datasetVariables.name: AEACNDEV
datasetVariables.label: Action Taken with Device
datasetVariables.description: An action taken with a device as the result of the event. The device may or may not be a device under study.

datasetVariables.name: AEREL
datasetVariables.label: Causality
datasetVariables.description: Records the investigator's opinion as to the causality of the event to the treatment. ICH does not establish any required or recommended terms for non-device relatedness. ICH E2A and E2B examples include (up-cased here for alignment to SDTM conventions) terms such as "NOT RELATED", "UNLIKELY RELATED", "POSSIBLY RELATED", "RELATED", but these example terms do not establish any conventions or expectations. Controlled terminology may be defined in the future. Check with regulatory authority for population of this variable.

datasetVariables.name: AERLDEV
datasetVariables.label: Relationship of Event to Device
datasetVariables.description:
A judgment as to the likelihood that the device caused the adverse event. The relationship is to a device identified in the data (i.e., has an SPDEVID). The device may be ancillary or under study. 
 Terminology: 
 * In the EU, follow the European Commission Guidelines on Medical Devices, Clinical Investigations: SAE Reporting (MEDDEV 2.7/3) (e.g., Not Related, Unlikely, Possible, Probable, Causal Relationship), with device-specific definitions. 
 * No required Controlled Terminology in US.

datasetVariables.name: AERELNST
datasetVariables.label: Relationship to Non-Study Treatment
datasetVariables.description: Records the investigator's opinion as to whether the event may have been due to a treatment other than study drug. May be reported as free text. Example: "MORE LIKELY RELATED TO ASPIRIN USE".

datasetVariables.name: AEPATT
datasetVariables.label: Pattern of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate the pattern of the event over time. Examples: "INTERMITTENT", "CONTINUOUS", "SINGLE EVENT".

datasetVariables.name: AEOUT
datasetVariables.label: Outcome of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Description of the outcome of an event.

datasetVariables.name: AESCAN
datasetVariables.label: Involves Cancer
datasetVariables.description: Was the serious event associated with the development of cancer? Valid values are "Y" and "N". This is a legacy seriousness criterion. It is not included in ICH E2A or E2B.

datasetVariables.name: AESCONG
datasetVariables.label: Congenital Anomaly or Birth Defect
datasetVariables.description: Was the serious event associated with congenital anomaly or birth defect? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESDISAB
datasetVariables.label: Persist or Signif Disability/Incapacity
datasetVariables.description: Did the serious event result in persistent or significant disability/incapacity? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESDTH
datasetVariables.label: Results in Death
datasetVariables.description: Did the serious event result in death? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESHOSP
datasetVariables.label: Requires or Prolongs Hospitalization
datasetVariables.description: Did the serious event require or prolong hospitalization? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESLIFE
datasetVariables.label: Is Life Threatening
datasetVariables.description: Was the serious event life-threatening? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESOD
datasetVariables.label: Occurred with Overdose
datasetVariables.description: Did the serious event occur with an overdose? Valid values are "Y" and "N". This is a legacy seriousness criterion. It is not included in ICH E2A or E2B.

datasetVariables.name: AESMIE
datasetVariables.label: Other Medically Important Serious Event
datasetVariables.description: Do additional categories for seriousness apply? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AESINTV
datasetVariables.label: Needs Intervention to Prevent Impairment
datasetVariables.description: Records whether medical or surgical intervention was necessary to preclude permanent impairment of a body function, or to prevent permanent damage to a body structure, with either situation suspected to be due to the use of a medical product. This variable is used in conjunction with the other "seriousness" variables (e.g., fatal, life-threatening). It is part of the US federal government definition of a serious adverse event; see 21 CFR Part 803.3(w)(3).

datasetVariables.name: AEUNANT
datasetVariables.label: Unanticipated Adverse Device Effect
datasetVariables.description:
Any serious adverse effect on health or safety or any life-threatening problem or death caused by or associated with a device, if that effect, problem, or death was not previously identified in nature, severity, or degree of incidence in the investigational plan or application (including a supplementary plan or application), 
 or 
 any other unanticipated serious problem associated with a device that relates to the rights, safety, or welfare of subjects. (21 CFR Part 812.3(s)). 
 This variable applies only to serious AEs and should hold collected data; if the value is derived, it should be held in ADaM.

datasetVariables.name: AERLPRT
datasetVariables.label: Rel of AE to Non-Dev-Rel Study Activity
datasetVariables.description:
The investigator's opinion as to the causality of the event as related to other protocol-required activities, actions, or assessments (e.g., medication changes, tests/assessments, other procedures). The relationship is to a protocol-specified, non-device-related activity where the device is identified in the data (i.e., has an SPDEVID). The device may be ancillary or under study. 
 Terminology: 
 * In the EU, follow the European Commission Guidelines on Medical Devices, Clinical Investigations: SAE Reporting (MEDDEV 2.7/3) (e.g., Not Related, Unlikely, Possible, Probable, Causal Relationship), with device-specific definitions. 
 * No required Controlled Terminology in US.

self.title: Rel of AE to Non-Dev-Rel Study Activity

datasetVariables.name: AERLPRC
datasetVariables.label: Rel of AE to Device-Related Procedure
datasetVariables.description:
The investigator's opinion as to the likelihood that the device-related study procedure (e.g., implant/insertion, revision/adjustment, explant/removal) caused the AE. The relationship is to a device-related procedure where the device is identified in the data (i.e., has an SPDEVID). The device may be ancillary or under study. 
 Terminology: 
 * In the EU, follow the European Commission Guidelines on Medical Devices, Clinical Investigations: SAE Reporting (MEDDEV 2.7/3) (e.g., Not Related, Unlikely, Possible, Probable, Causal Relationship), with device-specific definitions. 
 * No required Controlled Terminology in US.

self.title: Rel of AE to Device-Related Procedure

datasetVariables.name: AECONTRT
datasetVariables.label: Concomitant or Additional Trtmnt Given
datasetVariables.description: Was another treatment given because of the occurrence of the event? Valid values are "Y" and "N".

datasetVariables.name: AETOXGR
datasetVariables.label: Standard Toxicity Grade
datasetVariables.description: Toxicity grade according to a standard toxicity scale (e.g., Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events, CTCAE). Sponsors should specify the name of the scale and version used in the metadata (see assumption 7d). If value is from a numeric scale, represent only the number (e.g., "2", not "Grade 2").

datasetVariables.name: TAETORD
datasetVariables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
datasetVariables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm.

self.title: Planned Order of Element within Arm

datasetVariables.name: EPOCH
datasetVariables.label: Epoch
datasetVariables.description: Epoch associated with the start date/time of the adverse event. Examples: "SCREENING", "TREATMENT", "FOLLOW-UP".

datasetVariables.name: AESTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Start Date/Time of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Start date/time of the adverse event represented in ISO 8601 character format.

datasetVariables.name: AEENDTC
datasetVariables.label: End Date/Time of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: End date/time of the adverse event represented in ISO 8601 character format.

datasetVariables.name: AESTDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of Start of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Study day of start of adverse event relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

self.title: Study Day of Start of Adverse Event

datasetVariables.name: AEENDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of End of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Study day of end of event relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

self.title: Study Day of End of Adverse Event

datasetVariables.name: AEDUR
datasetVariables.label: Duration of Adverse Event
datasetVariables.description: Collected duration and unit of an adverse event. Used only if collected on the CRF and not derived from start and end date/times. Example: "P1DT2H" (for 1 day, 2 hours).

datasetVariables.name: AEENRF
datasetVariables.label: End Relative to Reference Period
datasetVariables.description: Describes the end of the event relative to the sponsor-defined reference period. The sponsor-defined reference period is a continuous period of time defined by a discrete starting point (RFSTDTC) and a discrete ending point (RFENDTC) of the trial. \n Not all values of the codelist are allowable for this variable. See Section 4.4.7, Use of Relative Timing Variables.

datasetVariables.name: AEENRTPT
datasetVariables.label: End Relative to Reference Time Point
datasetVariables.description: Identifies the end of the event as being before or after the reference time point defined by variable AEENTPT. \n Not all values of the codelist are allowable for this variable. See Section 4.4.7, Use of Relative Timing Variables.

self.title: End Relative to Reference Time Point

datasetVariables.name: AEENTPT
datasetVariables.label: End Reference Time Point
datasetVariables.description: Description of date/time in ISO 8601 character format of the reference point referred to by AEENRTPT. Examples: "2003-12-25", "VISIT 2".

datasets.name: LB
datasets.label: Laboratory Test Results
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per lab test per time point per visit per subject

datasetVariables.name: STUDYID
datasetVariables.label: Study Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

datasetVariables.name: DOMAIN
datasetVariables.label: Domain Abbreviation
datasetVariables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

datasetVariables.name: USUBJID
datasetVariables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

datasetVariables.name: LBSEQ
datasetVariables.label: Sequence Number
datasetVariables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. May be any valid number.

datasetVariables.name: LBGRPID
datasetVariables.label: Group ID
datasetVariables.description: Used to tie together a block of related records in a single domain for a subject.

datasetVariables.name: LBREFID
datasetVariables.label: Specimen ID
datasetVariables.description: Internal or external specimen identifier. Example: specimen ID.

datasetVariables.name: LBSPID
datasetVariables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Sponsor-defined reference number. May be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database. Example: Line number on the Lab page.

datasetVariables.name: LBTESTCD
datasetVariables.label: Lab Test or Examination Short Name
datasetVariables.description: Short name of the measurement, test, or examination described in LBTEST. It can be used as a column name when converting a dataset from a vertical to a horizontal format. The value in LBTESTCD cannot be longer than 8 characters, nor can it start with a number (e.g., "1TEST" is not valid). LBTESTCD cannot contain characters other than letters, numbers, or underscores. Examples: "ALT", "LDH".

self.title: Lab Test or Examination Short Name

datasetVariables.name: LBTEST
datasetVariables.label: Lab Test or Examination Name
datasetVariables.description: Verbatim name of the test or examination used to obtain the measurement or finding. Note: Any test normally performed by a clinical laboratory is considered a lab test. The value in LBTEST cannot be longer than 40 characters. Examples: "Alanine Aminotransferase", "Lactate Dehydrogenase".

datasetVariables.name: LBTSTCND
datasetVariables.label: Test Condition
datasetVariables.description: Identifies any planned condition imposed by the assay system on the specimen at the time the test is performed.

datasetVariables.name: LBBDAGNT
datasetVariables.label: Binding Agent
datasetVariables.description: The textual description of the agent that is binding to the entity in the LBTEST variable. The LBBDAGNT variable is used to indicate that there is a binding relationship between the entities in the LBTEST and LBBDAGNT variables, regardless of direction. \n LBBDAGNT is not a method qualifier. It should only be used when the actual interest of the measurement is the binding interaction between the 2 entities in LBTEST and LBBDAGNT. In other words, the combination of LBTEST and LBBDAGNT should describe the thing, the entity, or the analyte being measured, without the need for additional variables. \n The binding agent may be (but is not limited to) a test article, a portion of the test article, a related compound, or an endogenous molecule.

datasetVariables.name: LBTSTOPO
datasetVariables.label: Test Operational Objective
datasetVariables.description: Text description of the high-level purpose of the test at the operational level.

datasetVariables.name: LBCAT
datasetVariables.label: Category for Lab Test
datasetVariables.description: Used to define a category of related records across subjects. Examples: "HEMATOLOGY", "URINALYSIS", "CHEMISTRY".

datasetVariables.name: LBSCAT
datasetVariables.label: Subcategory for Lab Test
datasetVariables.description: A further categorization of a test category. Examples: "DIFFERENTIAL", "COAGULATION", "LIVER FUNCTION", "ELECTROLYTES".

datasetVariables.name: LBORRES
datasetVariables.label: Result or Finding in Original Units
datasetVariables.description: Result of the measurement or finding as originally received or collected.

self.title: Result or Finding in Original Units

datasetVariables.name: LBORRESU
datasetVariables.label: Original Units
datasetVariables.description: Original units in which the data were collected. The unit for LBORRES. Example: "g/L".

datasetVariables.name: LBRESSCL
datasetVariables.label: Result Scale
datasetVariables.description: Classifies the scale of the original result value; for example, whether the result is ordinal, nominal, quantitative, or narrative.

datasetVariables.name: LBRESTYP
datasetVariables.label: Result Type
datasetVariables.description: Classifies the kind of result (i.e., property type) originally reported for the test. Examples include substance concentration, proportion, mass rate, and arbitrary concentration.

datasetVariables.name: LBCOLSRT
datasetVariables.label: Collected Summary Result Type
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate the type of collected summary result. This includes source summary results collected on a CRF or provided by an external vendor (e.g., central lab). If the summary result is derived by the sponsor using individual source data records from SDTM, the derived summary result is represented in ADaM. If the summary result is produced and reported by the lab, the collected summary result is represented in SDTM.

datasetVariables.name: LBORNRLO
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range Lower Limit in Orig Unit
datasetVariables.description: Lower end of reference range for continuous measurement in original units. Should be populated only for continuous results.

self.title: Reference Range Lower Limit in Orig Unit

datasetVariables.name: LBORNRHI
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range Upper Limit in Orig Unit
datasetVariables.description: Upper end of reference range for continuous measurement in original units. Should be populated only for continuous results.

self.title: Reference Range Upper Limit in Orig Unit

datasetVariables.name: LBLLOD
datasetVariables.label: Lower Limit of Detection
datasetVariables.description: The lowest threshold (as originally received or collected) for reliably detecting the presence or absence of substance measured by a specific test. The value for the field will be as described in documentation from the instrument or lab vendor.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTRESC
datasetVariables.label: Character Result/Finding in Std Format
datasetVariables.description: Contains the result value for all findings, copied or derived from LBORRES in a standard format or standard units. LBSTRESC should store all results or findings in character format; if results are numeric, they should also be stored in numeric format in LBSTRESN. For example, if a test has results "NONE", "NEG", and "NEGATIVE" in LBORRES and these results effectively have the same meaning, they could be represented in standard format in LBSTRESC as "NEGATIVE". For other examples, see Original and Standardized Results.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTRESN
datasetVariables.label: Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units
datasetVariables.description: Used for continuous or numeric results or findings in standard format; copied in numeric format from LBSTRESC. LBSTRESN should store all numeric test results or findings.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTRESU
datasetVariables.label: Standard Units
datasetVariables.description: Standardized unit used for LBSTRESC or LBSTRESN.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTNRLO
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range Lower Limit-Std Units
datasetVariables.description: Lower end of reference range for continuous measurements for LBSTRESC/LBSTRESN in standardized units. Should be populated only for continuous results.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTNRHI
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range Upper Limit-Std Units
datasetVariables.description: Upper end of reference range for continuous measurements in standardized units. Should be populated only for continuous results.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTNRC
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range for Char Rslt-Std Units
datasetVariables.description: For normal range values that are character in ordinal scale or if categorical ranges were supplied. Examples: "-1 to +1", "NEGATIVE TO TRACE".

self.title: Reference Range for Char Rslt-Std Units

datasetVariables.name: LBNRIND
datasetVariables.label: Reference Range Indicator
datasetVariables.description: Indicates where the value falls with respect to reference range defined by LBORNRLO and LBORNRHI, LBSTNRLO and LBSTNRHI, or by LBSTNRC. Examples: "NORMAL", "ABNORMAL", "HIGH", "LOW". Sponsors should specify in the study metadata (Comments column in the Define-XML document) whether LBNRIND refers to the original or standard reference ranges and results. LBNRIND is not used to indicate clinical significance.

datasetVariables.name: LBSTAT
datasetVariables.label: Completion Status
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate exam not done. Should be null if a result exists in LBORRES.

datasetVariables.name: LBREASND
datasetVariables.label: Reason Test Not Done
datasetVariables.description: Describes why a measurement or test was not performed. Examples: "BROKEN EQUIPMENT", "SUBJECT REFUSED", or "SPECIMEN LOST". Used in conjunction with LBSTAT when value is "NOT DONE".

datasetVariables.name: LBNAM
datasetVariables.label: Vendor Name
datasetVariables.description: The name or identifier of the laboratory that performed the test.

datasetVariables.name: LBLOINC
datasetVariables.label: LOINC Code
datasetVariables.description: Code for the lab test from the LOINC code system. The sponsor is expected to provide the dictionary name and version used to map the terms utilizing the Define-XML external codelist attributes.

datasetVariables.name: LBSPEC
datasetVariables.label: Specimen Type
datasetVariables.description: Defines the type of specimen used for a measurement. Examples: "SERUM", "PLASMA", "URINE".

datasetVariables.name: LBSPCCND
datasetVariables.label: Specimen Condition
datasetVariables.description: The physical state or quality of a sample for an assessment. Examples: "HEMOLYZED", "ICTERIC", "LIPEMIC".

datasetVariables.name: LBSPCUFL
datasetVariables.label: Specimen Usability for the Test
datasetVariables.description: Describes the usability of the specimen for the test. The value will be "N" if the specimen is not usable, and null if the specimen is usable.

datasetVariables.name: LBMETHOD
datasetVariables.label: Method of Test or Examination
datasetVariables.description: Method of the test or examination. Examples: "EIA" (enzyme immunoassay), "ELECTROPHORESIS", "DIPSTICK".

datasetVariables.name: LBANMETH
datasetVariables.label: Analysis Method
datasetVariables.description: Analysis method applied to obtain a summarized result. Analysis method describes the method of secondary processing applied to a complex observation result (e.g., a calculation used to measure eGFR).

datasetVariables.name: LBTMTHSN
datasetVariables.label: Test Method Sensitivity
datasetVariables.description: The sensitivity of the test methodology with respect to observation, detection, or quantification.

datasetVariables.name: LBLOBXFL
datasetVariables.label: Last Observation Before Exposure Flag
datasetVariables.description: Operationally derived indicator used to identify the last non-missing value prior to RFXSTDTC. The value should be "Y" or null.

datasetVariables.name: LBBLFL
datasetVariables.label: Baseline Flag
datasetVariables.description: Indicator used to identify a baseline value. Should be "Y" or null. Note that LBBLFL is retained for backward compatibility. The authoritative baseline for statistical analysis is in an ADaM dataset.

datasetVariables.name: LBFAST
datasetVariables.label: Fasting Status
datasetVariables.description: Indicator used to identify fasting status. Examples: "Y", "N".

datasetVariables.name: LBDRVFL
datasetVariables.label: Derived Flag
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate a derived record. The value should be "Y" or null. Records that represent the average of other records, or do not come from the CRF, or are not as originally received or collected are examples of records that might be derived for the submission datasets. If LBDRVFL="Y", then LBORRES may be null, with LBSTRESC and (if numeric) LBSTRESN having the derived value.

datasetVariables.name: LBTOX
datasetVariables.label: Toxicity
datasetVariables.description: Description of toxicity quantified by LBTOXGR. The sponsor is expected to provide the name of the scale and version used to map the terms, utilizing the external codelist element in the Define-XML document.

datasetVariables.name: LBTOXGR
datasetVariables.label: Standard Toxicity Grade
datasetVariables.description: Records toxicity grade value using a standard toxicity scale (e.g., the NCI CTCAE). If value is from a numeric scale, represent only the number (e.g., "2" not "Grade 2"). The sponsor is expected to provide the name of the scale and version used to map the terms, utilizing the external codelist element in the Define-XML document.

datasetVariables.name: LBCLSIG
datasetVariables.label: Clinically Significant, Collected
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate whether a collected observation is clinically significant based on judgment.

datasetVariables.name: VISITNUM
datasetVariables.label: Visit Number
datasetVariables.description: Clinical encounter number. Numeric version of VISIT, used for sorting.

datasetVariables.name: VISIT
datasetVariables.label: Visit Name
datasetVariables.description: Protocol-defined description of clinical encounter. May be used in addition to VISITNUM and/or VISITDY.

datasetVariables.name: VISITDY
datasetVariables.label: Planned Study Day of Visit
datasetVariables.description: Planned study day of the visit based upon RFSTDTC in Demographics.

datasetVariables.name: TAETORD
datasetVariables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
datasetVariables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm.

self.title: Planned Order of Element within Arm

datasetVariables.name: EPOCH
datasetVariables.label: Epoch
datasetVariables.description: Epoch associated with the start date/time of the observation, or the date/time of collection if start date/time is not collected.

datasetVariables.name: LBDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Specimen Collection
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of specimen collection represented in ISO 8601 character format.

datasetVariables.name: LBENDTC
datasetVariables.label: End Date/Time of Specimen Collection
datasetVariables.description: End date/time of specimen collection represented in ISO 8601 character format.

datasetVariables.name: LBDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of Specimen Collection
datasetVariables.description: Study day of specimen collection, measured as integer days. Algorithm for calculations must be relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC variable in Demographics. This formula should be consistent across the submission.

datasetVariables.name: LBENDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of End of Observation
datasetVariables.description: Actual study day of end of observation expressed in integer days relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC in Demographics.

self.title: Study Day of End of Observation

datasetVariables.name: LBTPT
datasetVariables.label: Planned Time Point Name
datasetVariables.description: Text description of time when specimen should be taken. This may be represented as an elapsed time relative to a fixed reference point, such as time of last dose. See LBTPTNUM and LBTPTREF. Examples: "Start", "5 min post".

datasetVariables.name: LBTPTNUM
datasetVariables.label: Planned Time Point Number
datasetVariables.description: Numerical version of LBTPT to aid in sorting.

datasetVariables.name: LBELTM
datasetVariables.label: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref
datasetVariables.description: Planned elapsed time (in ISO 8601) relative to a planned fixed reference (LBTPTREF). This variable is useful where there are repetitive measures. Not a clock time or a date/time variable. Represented as ISO 8601 duration. Examples: "-PT15M" to represent the period of 15 minutes prior to the reference point indicated by LBTPTREF, "PT8H" to represent the period of 8 hours after the reference point indicated by LBTPTREF.

self.title: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref

datasetVariables.name: LBTPTREF
datasetVariables.label: Time Point Reference
datasetVariables.description: Name of the fixed reference point referred to by LBELTM, LBTPTNUM, and LBTPT. Examples: "PREVIOUS DOSE", "PREVIOUS MEAL".

datasetVariables.name: LBRFTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Reference Time Point
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of the reference time point, LBTPTREF.

datasetVariables.name: LBPTFL
datasetVariables.label: Point in Time Flag
datasetVariables.description: An indication that the specimen was collected at a single point in time. The value is "Y" or null. The intent of this variable in the LB domain is to aid mapping to LOINC codes in the dataset, when LOINC part "Time Aspect" = "Pt".

datasetVariables.name: LBPDUR
datasetVariables.label: Planned Duration
datasetVariables.description: Planned duration of specimen collection. If LBPTFL is "Y" then LBPDUR is null.

datasets.name: VS
datasets.label: Vital Signs
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per vital sign measurement per time point per visit per subject

datasetVariables.name: STUDYID
datasetVariables.label: Study Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

datasetVariables.name: DOMAIN
datasetVariables.label: Domain Abbreviation
datasetVariables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

datasetVariables.name: USUBJID
datasetVariables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

datasetVariables.name: VSSEQ
datasetVariables.label: Sequence Number
datasetVariables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. May be any valid number.

datasetVariables.name: VSGRPID
datasetVariables.label: Group ID
datasetVariables.description: Used to tie together a block of related records in a single domain for a subject.

datasetVariables.name: VSSPID
datasetVariables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
datasetVariables.description: Sponsor-defined reference number. May be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database.

datasetVariables.name: VSTESTCD
datasetVariables.label: Vital Signs Test Short Name
datasetVariables.description: Short name of the measurement, test, or examination described in VSTEST. It can be used as a column name when converting a dataset from a vertical to a horizontal format. The value in VSTESTCD cannot be longer than 8 characters, nor can it start with a number (e.g., "1TEST" is not valid). VSTESTCD cannot contain characters other than letters, numbers, or underscores. Examples: "SYSBP", "DIABP", "BMI".

datasetVariables.name: VSTEST
datasetVariables.label: Vital Signs Test Name
datasetVariables.description: Verbatim name of the test or examination used to obtain the measurement or finding. The value in VSTEST cannot be longer than 40 characters. Examples: "Systolic Blood Pressure", "Diastolic Blood Pressure", "Body Mass Index".

datasetVariables.name: VSCAT
datasetVariables.label: Category for Vital Signs
datasetVariables.description: Used to define a category of related records.

datasetVariables.name: VSSCAT
datasetVariables.label: Subcategory for Vital Signs
datasetVariables.description: A further categorization of a measurement or examination.

datasetVariables.name: VSPOS
datasetVariables.label: Vital Signs Position of Subject
datasetVariables.description: Position of the subject during a measurement or examination. Examples: "SUPINE", "STANDING", "SITTING".

datasetVariables.name: VSORRES
datasetVariables.label: Result or Finding in Original Units
datasetVariables.description: Result of the vital signs measurement as originally received or collected.

self.title: Result or Finding in Original Units

datasetVariables.name: VSORRESU
datasetVariables.label: Original Units
datasetVariables.description: Original units in which the data were collected. The unit for VSORRES. Examples: "in", "LB", "beats/min".

datasetVariables.name: VSSTRESC
datasetVariables.label: Character Result/Finding in Std Format
datasetVariables.description: Contains the result value for all findings, copied or derived from VSORRES in a standard format or standard units. VSSTRESC should store all results or findings in character format; if results are numeric, they should also be stored in numeric format in VSSTRESN. For example, if a test has results "NONE", "NEG", and "NEGATIVE" in VSORRES, and these results effectively have the same meaning, they could be represented in standard format in VSSTRESC as "NEGATIVE".

datasetVariables.name: VSSTRESN
datasetVariables.label: Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units
datasetVariables.description: Used for continuous or numeric results or findings in standard format; copied in numeric format from VSSTRESC. VSSTRESN should store all numeric test results or findings.

datasetVariables.name: VSSTRESU
datasetVariables.label: Standard Units
datasetVariables.description: Standardized unit used for VSSTRESC and VSSTRESN.

datasetVariables.name: VSSTAT
datasetVariables.label: Completion Status
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate that a vital sign measurement was not done. Should be null if a result exists in VSORRES.

datasetVariables.name: VSREASND
datasetVariables.label: Reason Not Performed
datasetVariables.description: Describes why a measurement or test was not performed. Examples: "BROKEN EQUIPMENT", "SUBJECT REFUSED". Used in conjunction with VSSTAT when value is "NOT DONE".

datasetVariables.name: VSLOC
datasetVariables.label: Location of Vital Signs Measurement
datasetVariables.description: Location relevant to the collection of vital signs measurement. Example: "ARM" for blood pressure.

datasetVariables.name: VSLAT
datasetVariables.label: Laterality
datasetVariables.description: Qualifier for anatomical location or specimen further detailing laterality. Examples: "RIGHT", "LEFT", "BILATERAL".

datasetVariables.name: VSLOBXFL
datasetVariables.label: Last Observation Before Exposure Flag
datasetVariables.description: Operationally derived indicator used to identify the last non-missing value prior to RFXSTDTC. Should be "Y" or null.

datasetVariables.name: VSBLFL
datasetVariables.label: Baseline Flag
datasetVariables.description: Indicator used to identify a baseline value. Should be "Y" or null. Note that VSBLFL is retained for backward compatibility. The authoritative baseline for statistical analysis is in an ADaM dataset.

datasetVariables.name: VSDRVFL
datasetVariables.label: Derived Flag
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate a derived record. The value should be "Y" or null. Records that represent the average of other records or that do not come from the CRF are examples of records that would be derived for the submission datasets. If VSDRVFL = "Y," then VSORRES may be null, with VSSTRESC and (if numeric) VSSTRESN having the derived value.

datasetVariables.name: VSTOX
datasetVariables.label: Toxicity
datasetVariables.description: Description of toxicity quantified by VSTOXGR. The sponsor is expected to provide the name of the scale and version used to map the terms, utilizing the external codelist element in the Define-XML document.

datasetVariables.name: VSTOXGR
datasetVariables.label: Standard Toxicity Grade
datasetVariables.description: Records toxicity grade value using a standard toxicity scale (e.g., NCI CTCAE). If value is from a numeric scale, represent only the number (e.g., "2", not "Grade 2"). The sponsor is expected to provide the name of the scale and version used to map the terms, utilizing the external codelist element in the Define-XML document.

datasetVariables.name: VSCLSIG
datasetVariables.label: Clinically Significant, Collected
datasetVariables.description: Used to indicate whether a collected observation is clinically significant based on judgment.

datasetVariables.name: VISITNUM
datasetVariables.label: Visit Number
datasetVariables.description: Clinical encounter number. Numeric version of VISIT, used for sorting.

datasetVariables.name: VISIT
datasetVariables.label: Visit Name
datasetVariables.description: Protocol-defined description of clinical encounter. May be used in addition to VISITNUM and/or VISITDY.

datasetVariables.name: VISITDY
datasetVariables.label: Planned Study Day of Visit
datasetVariables.description: Planned study day of the visit based upon RFSTDTC in Demographics.

datasetVariables.name: TAETORD
datasetVariables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
datasetVariables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm.

self.title: Planned Order of Element within Arm

datasetVariables.name: EPOCH
datasetVariables.label: Epoch
datasetVariables.description: Epoch associated with the start date/time at which the assessment was made.

datasetVariables.name: VSDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Measurements
datasetVariables.description: Date and time of the vital signs assessment represented in ISO 8601 character format.

datasetVariables.name: VSDY
datasetVariables.label: Study Day of Vital Signs
datasetVariables.description: Study day of vital signs measurements, measured as integer days. Algorithm for calculations must be relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC variable in Demographics.

datasetVariables.name: VSTPT
datasetVariables.label: Planned Time Point Name
datasetVariables.description: Text description of time when measurement should be taken. This may be represented as an elapsed time relative to a fixed reference point (e.g., time of last dose). See VSTPTNUM and VSTPTREF. Examples: "START", "5 MIN POST".

datasetVariables.name: VSTPTNUM
datasetVariables.label: Planned Time Point Number
datasetVariables.description: Numerical version of VSTPT to aid in sorting.

datasetVariables.name: VSELTM
datasetVariables.label: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref
datasetVariables.description: Planned elapsed time (in ISO 8601) relative to a planned fixed reference (VSTPTREF). This variable is useful where there are repetitive measures. Not a clock time or a date time variable. Represented as an ISO 8601 Duration. Examples: "-PT15M" to represent the period of 15 minutes prior to the reference point indicated by VSTPTREF, "PT8H" to represent the period of 8 hours after the reference point indicated by VSTPTREF.

self.title: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref

datasetVariables.name: VSTPTREF
datasetVariables.label: Time Point Reference
datasetVariables.description: Name of the fixed reference point referred to by VSELTM, VSTPTNUM, and VSTPT. Examples: "PREVIOUS DOSE", "PREVIOUS MEAL".

datasetVariables.name: VSRFTDTC
datasetVariables.label: Date/Time of Reference Time Point
datasetVariables.description: Date/time of the reference time point, VSTPTREF.
